Definition: Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Michmas or Michmash = "hidden"; 1) a city in Benjamin lying near Ramah and approximately 10 miles (16 km) north of Jerusalem; probably modern 'Mukhmas'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
